title: Hubs and the irreducible distance: what is proved
claim: H1: kappa(sigma u_1..sigma u_n) = kappa_n(sigma) prod mu_i for independent u_i (NAE hung knots give two copies each, parity hung knots one per two distinctions). H2: a hub shortcuts the cumulant distance only with at least 32 copies (log3|kappa_34(coin)| = 64.075 > 64); no single hub on a distinction in at most 15 knots can (spread and nested hubs open). K1: if C(x,y) != 0, delta_K = tau. K2: on parity bases delta_K = delta = bond distance - 1. K3: delta_K ignores hubs. K4: delta_K = steps apart on NAE trees, parity trees and mixed trees whose path has no parity knot; open with a parity knot on the path (sketch). Narrowed after referee R1: delta_K is irreducibility in cumulants, a relative of K2 (zero correlation, not freedom); on a mixed cycle (NAE path closed by a parity knot) it misreads the parity knot as k steps and fails the triangle inequality.
standard_statement: Joint cumulants of a fair coin (tangent numbers); Brillinger's law of total cumulance; matroid circuits; irreducible correlation sets.
prior_work: CUMULANT-DIST-20261118-001 (D0-D6); DISTANCE-ORDER-20261117-001 (tau = steps on NAE trees); classical: tangent numbers, Brillinger, Zwiernik-Smith tree cumulants, Schneidman et al.
completion_gate: Ticket B's gates (hub identity, threshold, irreducible search) and frozen run; the referee reviews the proofs.

validation.status: proofs written with the run; refereed R1 (confirmed with fixes, no Block on trees and single-law bases)
validation.independence: brute-force solution sets and computed readings against the statements; same task authorship

attained_result: H1, H2, K1-K3 proved; K4 proved except mixed paths with a parity knot (sketch; computed).
